Vd.bar_b_note: All three frames on both sides show a dark brown walled arena ring with banners and a thin lightning column instead of the board's colossal split tree with a crown, bark, walkways and warm lantern light, so the landmark sinks it. Gap to 7.5: model the Stormheart as a trunk with a branching canopy silhouette above the arena, show the core as a lit split in the bark, and add warm lanterns against the purple storm sky.

Ug.bar_b_note: Fenn, Oswin and Elder Maud now have distinct lines and appealing portraits, but the Fenn frame is a black void with no speaker or scene behind the box and the other two are flat midday frames with a plain dialogue panel, so the finish falls short. Gap to 7.5: render Fenn's scene and stage him in frame, frame speakers with a closer over-shoulder camera and rim light, and theme the dialogue panel with the pale border and gold name plate.

Qc.bar_b_note: The 'after' frame is still a full exploration HUD (TEAM 5/5, all-green bars, Main Story card, action row) with a plain line of text across the middle and a tiny 'creature is beaten' tag, so no result moment reads. Gap to 7.5: add a dedicated result panel (loss vs win banner, fainted party members greyed, rewards or penalties listed), dim or hide the exploration HUD during it, and frame the camera on the outcome.

Hw.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra keeps the owner-bar fleece, curled horns and blue gem and stands taller than the trainer, but the neutral stage has no Valheim-class light or atmosphere. A's hit react is the same as standing and its faint end has legs splayed up; B's faint mid/end collapses into a legless fleece lump with horns stretched into flat black tubes. Gap to 7.5: give a visible flinch for the hit react, keep the legs folded under the body in faint, and stop the horns deforming.

Pv.bar_b_note: Every frame on both sides is one flat teal leaf carpet to a bare horizon, with a few thin scattered trees and a flat lilac sky, so no ancient-forest depth or fog layering reads. Gap to 7.5: mass trunks into groves and dark tree walls in the midground, break the ground with roots, black pools and moss mounds, and layer blue-violet fog bands toward the horizon.

Xs.bar_b_note: The gold Voltarach reads, but the player's creature is barely findable in either side. A shows flat magenta ground rings and chevron slabs as the telegraphs (i06-i10, i15-i16, tell2 a-c). B has fewer slabs but the camera goes into dark trunk/foliage on i12-i15 and the fight disappears. Both are dim brown, so the fight is unreadable. Gap to 7.5: replace the magenta decals with real lightning/stone tells, push trunks out of the camera path or fade occluders, and give the player creature a rim light.

Tj.bar_b_note: The elder has a clear face and eyes, a strong white-hair silhouette and an earthy green/brown palette that fit the key art's trainer, but he is a soft toy-like render on a black backdrop with no environment light. Gap to 7.5: show him lit in a Stormwood scene with a cool rim light, add surface detail to cloth and leather, and add a defining prop or accessory for his identity.

Oh.bar_b_note: Stormglass now shows pale blue crystal shards on a boulder. Stormglass_crown reads as a boulder with beige wooden-looking spikes, and glowmoss is a flat lime blob with no glow, all set on a bare flat leaf carpet. Gap to 7.5: make the crown shards glassy and lightning-lit, give glowmoss emissive cyan-green tufts on a mound, and nest the nodes in authored spots (roots, pools).

Bi.bar_b_note: B's aftermaths are distinct per site: banners torn down and dropped (rows 1, 3, 5), the cage opened with a freed villager (row 2), and a smoke plume where the tent stood (row 4). A mostly leaves the Team Tether banners up (rows 1, 3, 5) and only drops small emblem stones or debris, so the win barely reads. Both have smeared, low-detail grass and a flat sky. Gap to 7.5: carry B's site-specific changes plus warmer post-win light, and sharpen the ground textures.

Uv.bar_b_note: Break now shows white-violet lightning bolts and a darker grade, but Calm and Building are near-identical lilac frames (Fading is not shown). The sky is a flat purple wash with no cloud structure. Gap to 7.5: give each phase its own sky (clear lilac / rolling cloud wall / bolt-lit / clearing), its own fog density and its own colour grade, and add wind on the foliage for Building.

He.bar_b_note: The gold-and-blue Voltarach is a strong board-faithful hero and no magenta slab shows at strike or impact while 'staggered - punish now' appears. But the player's creature is a tiny white spark under the spider, and the dense HUD covers about a third of the frame. Gap to 7.5: add a real lightning/impact effect at the hit, rim-light the player creature, and trim or fade the side HUD panels in combat.

top_changes.change: Break up the flat leaf carpet in every Stormwood frame: groves and tree walls, roots, black pools, moss mounds, layered blue-violet fog and a structured storm sky (Pv, Oh, Uv, Vd, Ug).
Replace the dark ring arena with a colossal Stormheart tree mesh that has a branching crown, split glowing core, walkways and warm lanterns (Vd).

Combat readability: replace the magenta decal telegraphs with real lightning/stone tells, fade trunks between the camera and the fight, rim-light the player creature, and give results a dedicated panel instead of exploration HUD text (Xs, He, Qc).
